grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and check your eligibility for Child Benefit

grants.description: Share details about the child or children you're claiming for
grants.purpose: To determine your entitlement to Child Benefit and calculate the correct payment amount

grants.description: Provide your bank or building society account details for Child Benefit payments
grants.purpose: To pay your Child Benefit into your chosen account every 4 weeks (or weekly if eligible)

grants.description: Share information about your partner's income and National Insurance number
grants.purpose: To determine if High Income Child Benefit Charge applies. If either you or your partner earn over £60,000, you may need to pay a tax charge.

grants.description: Allow HMRC to check existing benefit claims and National Insurance records
grants.purpose: To prevent duplicate claims, verify eligibility, calculate High Income Child Benefit Charge if applicable, and award National Insurance credits towards your State Pension

grants.description: Verify your child's birth or adoption certificate details
grants.purpose: To confirm your child's identity and your relationship to them. If birth registered outside UK, we'll verify passport or travel document used to enter UK.

revocation.mechanism: Contact Child Benefit Office by phone, post, or through your online account to stop your claim
revocation.effect: Child Benefit payments will stop. You'll lose National Insurance credits. You can restart payments at any time by contacting HMRC.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot provide bank account details on your behalf - you must enter these yourself. Agent cannot make decisions about payment preferences (opt in/opt out) without your explicit confirmation. Agent cannot claim for a child if someone else is already claiming for that child. Agent cannot modify partner income declarations without your verification. For edge cases like split families, joined families, fostering, or pre-settled status, agent will hand off to HMRC Child Benefit Office for human assessment.
